name: What types of pathway lighting are available for residential properties?
description: Available types include solar, low-voltage, and LED lighting. Materials range from brass and copper to weather-resistant composites.

mainEntity.name: What types of pathway lighting are available for residential properties?

acceptedAnswer.text: There are several types of pathway lighting suitable for residential properties, each offering distinct advantages. Common options include solar-powered lights, which are easy to install and energy-efficient but depend on sunlight exposure. Low-voltage lighting systems offer greater control over brightness and beam spread, requiring professional installation. LED lights are a popular choice across all types due to their longevity, energy efficiency, and wide range of color temperatures. Material options include durable metals like brass and copper, or weather-resistant composites, chosen based on desired aesthetic and durability.
